finish-rune.text: Seamless quiet magical rune ambience: a steady soft energy hum, gentle luminous shimmer and a faint airy human vowel tone without words. Smooth, mysterious and restrained, with no melody or distinct events. Designed as a background game loop. No speech, lyrics, bells, percussion or dramatic changes.

button-press.text: One ancient stone pressure plate being stepped down into a fitted stone socket. A short weighty low click-clack: muted gritty stone movement followed by a firm rounded slab seating against stone. Compact, tactile and restrained, like a small dungeon floor mechanism rather than a door. Dry isolated game sound with no wood, metal, sharp crack, debris, footsteps, voice, music or reverb.

button-release.text: One ancient stone pressure plate rising back out of a fitted stone socket. A short lighter inverse clack-click: a muted upward stone shift with gentle gritty friction, ending in a small rounded stone stop. Clearly paired with a heavy stone plate press but quieter and slightly higher. Dry isolated game sound with no wood, metal, spring twang, sharp crack, debris, footsteps, voice, music or reverb.

bridge-slide.text: A heavy stone bridge slab sliding outward slowly across a smooth stone floor. One steady low muffled grinding tone with almost no variation, dark and dense, ending in a soft dull stop. Monotone ancient dungeon mechanism, close dry isolated game sound. No pebbles, sharp scraping, metal, crash, earthquake, voice, music or reverb.

bridge-retract.text: A heavy stone bridge slab sliding backward into a stone wall. One steady low muffled grinding tone with almost no variation, dark and dense, fading slightly as it retreats and ending in a soft hollow stop. Monotone ancient dungeon mechanism, close dry isolated game sound. No pebbles, sharp scraping, metal, crash, earthquake, voice, music or reverb.

skeleton-arrow.text: One soft lightweight fantasy game bow shot. A muted gentle bowstring release blended with two thin dry wooden sticks lightly tapping and rattling once, followed by a tiny soft puff of air. Delicate, hollow and understated, with rounded transients, reduced high frequencies and a very short dry tail. One isolated shot. No sharp thwip, no heavy impact, no arrow hit, no gunshot, no voice, no music, no reverb.

jelly-death.text: A short layered Foley impact: one chicken egg cracking, one ripe watermelon hitting stone with a dense wet splat, and a small water splash. All three sounds occur together as one compact game effect. Close dry recording, short decay, no voice, no music, no reverb.

jelly-land.text: One large soft gel blob dropping once onto a stone floor. A clear loud low-pitched slap with a firm rounded attack and a dense muffled thud. Short, weighty and easy to hear in a game. One isolated impact only. No second hit, bounce, sharp click, splash, voice, music or reverb.

spikes.text: A single steel sword blade being drawn smoothly from a tight leather and metal scabbard. One compact rising metallic shing: controlled blade friction, a clean bright steel resonance and a subtle release at the end. Dense and tactile, quick but not aggressive, close dry isolated game sound. No sword strike, impact, combat swing, chains, coins, machinery, voice, music or reverb.

spikes-retract.text: A single steel sword blade being slid smoothly back into a tight leather and metal scabbard. One compact descending metallic shing: controlled blade friction, a muted steel resonance, ending with a soft firm seat in the sheath. Dense and tactile, quick but not aggressive, close dry isolated game sound. No sword strike, impact, combat swing, chains, coins, machinery, voice, music or reverb.

portal.text: One cold magical portal transporting a small creature. A deep frosty vibration swells inward, layered with a smooth icy resonance, fine crystalline trembling and a brief subzero shimmer. Hollow, spectral and tactile, with a soft onset and a short vibrating tail. Chilled blue energy, close isolated game sound. No liquid glug, no warm bass, no sharp glass break, no bell melody, no electric zap, no explosive whoosh, no voice or music.

dungeon-wind.text: Seamless ambience of low air moving through an ancient underground stone corridor. Hollow drafts, subtle pressure fluctuations and distant airy resonance. Quiet, spacious and uneasy, with no distinct repeating events. No voices, no choir, no music, no sudden sounds.

torch-light.text: A wooden match being struck and catching on a wall torch. One quick dry scratch of a match head on rough stone, a crisp little sulfur flare, then a soft rounded whoosh as a small oily flame catches and settles into a gentle crackle. Close, warm and intimate game sound, short and clear. No explosion, no big fire roar, no metal, no voice, no music, no reverb.

torch-out.text: A small torch flame being snuffed out. One short soft wet fizz like a fingertip pinching a candle wick, a quick fading hiss of steam and a faint airy puff of smoke. Quiet, close and gentle game sound with a fast decay. No water splash, no wind gust, no explosion, no voice, no music, no reverb.

skull-crack.text: One small stylised bone skull cracking with a muted dry snap and two tiny chalky fragments settling. Soft rounded transient, restrained volume and a very short tail for a friendly fantasy game result screen. No glass, explosion, horror, gore, sharp peak, voice, music or reverb.

ui-move.text: One tiny soft fantasy menu navigation tick. A light muted wooden click with a faint warm glassy touch, rounded and barely intrusive. Very short isolated interface sound. No sharp high frequency, bell, coin, keyboard, voice, music or reverb.

ui-confirm.text: One quiet low menu confirmation sound. A short padded wooden clack blended with a soft hollow low thump, confident but unobtrusive and rounded. Very short isolated interface sound. No sharp click, metal, slam, bass boom, voice, music or reverb.

crate-slide.text: Seamless quiet loop of a wooden crate being pushed slowly over an old smooth stone floor. Low soft wood rumble, muffled friction and sparse rounded creaks, steady and unobtrusive. Background game feedback with no sharp scrape, impact, crash, metal, voice, music or reverb.

jelly-wobble.text: Two soft gel cubes gently bumping together once. A small rounded rubbery wobble, quiet wet boop and brief elastic jiggle, friendly and understated. Short isolated game sound with no splash, pop, squeak, sharp impact, voice, music or reverb.

jelly-slap.text: One small soft jelly body landing on stone. A gentle low wet slap layered with a compact cushioned gel thump, rounded and quiet, designed to sit underneath another landing sound. Short isolated effect. No metal, splash, squeak, sharp click, voice, music or reverb.

level-build.text: A three second cozy fantasy level assembly sequence. Several heavy stone blocks fly through soft air with low rounded whooshes and settle into place with muted stone thuds, building rhythmically from sparse to complete. End with one warm restrained low magical chord that gently signals the level is ready. Smooth background game sound, no crashes, debris, sharp impacts, bright fanfare, drums, voice or long reverb.

lift-up.text: A compact fantasy stone lift rising for about two seconds. Soft low mechanical stone movement with a smooth gently ascending pitch and subtle wooden tension, ending in a quiet padded stop. Restrained background game sound. No harsh grinding, alarm, metal screech, crash, voice, music or reverb.

lift-down.text: A compact fantasy stone lift descending for about two seconds. Soft low mechanical stone movement with a smooth gently descending pitch and subtle wooden release, ending in a quiet padded stop. Restrained background game sound. No harsh grinding, alarm, metal screech, crash, voice, music or reverb.

torch-swoosh.text: One classic small fantasy torch ignition: a quick soft sweep of fire through air, then a warm rounded flame whoosh that catches and settles immediately. Smooth and restrained, close game sound. No match strike, explosion, roar, sharp crackle, voice, music or reverb.

portal-whoosh.text: One soft magical teleport whoosh for a small creature. Air folds inward with a smooth low airy sweep, passes through a warm spectral shimmer and releases in a short gentle outward whoosh. Rounded, mysterious and restrained. No coins, bells, glass, electric zap, explosion, voice, music or long reverb.

crystal-energy.text: Seamless quiet loop of a magical crystal emitting a continuous energy beam. Soft low electrical glow, smooth luminous hum and delicate flowing current with slow subtle movement. Calm background ambience, evenly sustained and unobtrusive. No crackling arcs, sharp zaps, alarm, melody, voice or dramatic changes.
